output.one_liner: An AI search engine for research that searches 400+ million scholarly articles and returns evidence-based answers linked to peer-reviewed papers.

auth.notes: API uses API_KEY; MCP uses OAuth2

evidence.snippet: OAuth will open in your browser automatically on first use.

access.notes: Free tier available with plan-dependent usage limits; no approval or sales process required.

evidence.snippet: It's self-serve and open to everyone.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Search usage counts against plan calls; usage limits depend on selected plan tier.

evidence.snippet: The Consensus API gives you the same paper search over REST
Search usage counts against plan calls, full-text excerpts are available on paid plans.
The server is hosted, so there's nothing to install: https://mcp.consensus.app/mcp

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free API tier, documented REST endpoint, official hosted MCP server, and existing Composio toolkit enable building today.

overview_evidence.snippet: Consensus provides evidence-based search across scientific research papers.
Consensus is an AI search engine for research.

unknown_reasons.auth: OAuth2 grant type not explicitly stated; authorization_code inferred from browser-based flow description.
unknown_reasons.api_surface: OpenAPI specification not documented; webhooks not documented; full API breadth beyond single search endpoint not documented.
